name: canvas
description: Push rendered Markdown, LaTeX math, Mermaid diagrams, charts, images and HTML pages to the Claude Canvas panel in VS Code (canvas_push tool, /canvas command, answers mirrored while the panel is open).

mirrorAnswers.title: Mirror every answer
mirrorAnswers.description: Also copy every final answer to the canvas while the panel is open. Off: the model pushes only what is better rendered (math, figures, diagrams, images, long tables).
